rationale: The supplied measurement facts indicate broad product-semantic, runtime, cross-host, and cross-owner impact. Compact Delivery is ineligible because completed Brownfield analysis and stored quick_task context are not evidenced; Verified Change is also ineligible because there are multiple canonical owners and deterministic propagation is false. This is a non-authorizing benchmark candidate only.
decision_grounds: Synthetic durable UR is approved for measurement.
The change affects product semantics and runtime behavior across hosts.
Six canonical owners and eight source paths indicate cross-owner breadth.
Deterministic propagation is false while eight derived paths are affected.
No completed Brownfield analysis is evidenced.
No stored quick_task context is evidenced.
The classification does not constitute a Mode/Slice Decision or approval.
